verdict.line: You lose if you eat Thundering Smash into a trade or stand in Sky Splitter's blast; you win if you parry his stun with Riposte and chain Lunge resets to outheal his sustain.

brief.thesis: The numbers sit almost dead even (50.3% Fiora win rate over 1454 games) because each side has a hard counter to the other's engage: Riposte eats Thundering Smash whole, while an undisciplined Lunge walks straight into Frenzied Maul's on-hit burst and recast heal. Whoever respects the other's cooldown first wins the lane, which is exactly why the standing read on this matchup is just 'avoid E, parry Q or R, hit the passive with Q.'

theirWindow.when: Right after he lands first W
theirWindow.what: Frenzied Maul (W, 5s cooldown) marks whoever it hits, and recasting on that mark deals bonus damage and heals Volibear while his passive stacks him attack speed off every hit landed. Back off or trade away the instant you see the mark instead of standing in range for the recast.

yourWindow.when: The moment his Q is spent
yourWindow.what: Thundering Smash (Q, 12-10s cooldown) is his only stun, so once it's on cooldown you can freely double-dash with Lunge (Q) to proc your passive's healing without risking a stun chaining into Frenzied Maul burst.

runes.keystoneWhy: This is an extended-trade lane where both sides lean on sustain (his passive attack speed and W heal vs. your passive regen) — Conqueror's stacking heal rewards staying in extended fights rather than a single burst window.

summoners.why: 50.6% win rate and the overwhelming pick (90.5%) — Ignite punishes his all-ins and directly offsets the heal he gets from recasting Frenzied Maul.

playing.title: Bait Thundering Smash onto Riposte
playing.detail: His Q gains speed toward you and stuns plus damages the first champion he attacks; pop W (Riposte) the instant he commits so it parries that attack and reflects magic damage back.

playing.title: Disengage the moment his W marks you
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul (W, 5s cooldown) marks on hit, and a second cast on the same mark deals bonus damage and heals him — trade away before he gets the recast.

playing.title: Never stand still for Sky Splitter
playing.detail: E is a 1200-range skillshot that slows, damages, and shields him if he's caught in it; hold position just outside its radius and only commit to trades once it's down (16s cooldown).

playing.title: Double-dash Q for free damage
playing.detail: Lunge can be cast a second time within a couple seconds at no mana cost — use the first hit to proc your passive's healing and the second to reposition before his stun is back up.

playing.title: Save Riposte for his all-in, not minions
playing.detail: Riposte also works on large minions and monsters, but in this lane hold it for when he presses Q or leaps in with R so you deny the hit and get a free parried counter.

playing.title: Pop Burst of Speed the moment he commits
playing.detail: E grants attack speed, and every attack or Lunge landed during it adds move speed — use it right as he engages to either chain extra hits for the heal or kite out before his next Frenzied Maul.

playing.title: Hold Blade Waltz for isolated picks
playing.detail: R has a long cooldown (130-110s) and only hits champions, with diminishing damage on repeated hits to the same target — save it for when he's split from jungle or support, not a contested 2v2.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the tactical reasoning — when to parry, when to disengage, how to bait his cooldowns — is my own read of the ability kit, not OP.GG's.
